obligations.text: spec-spine.toml [layout] derived_dir is .statecraft/derived, every committed registry and codebase-index shard lives under .statecraft/derived/ and is fresh, no file remains under .derived/, and every tool, hook and document that names the derived directory names .statecraft/derived/.

record.summary: Authorizes moving spec-spine's committed derived directory from .derived/ to .statecraft/derived/, the path Statecraft profile revision 22 treats as generated. Revision 22's policy guard ignores .statecraft/derived/ but not .derived/, so while the shards live at .derived/ a spec-spine pin move cannot regenerate them in its own pull request (spec 061 D-4). The move lands as three pull requests because the guard keeps spec-spine.toml apart from every other non-generated path.
record.title: Move the committed derived directory to .statecraft/derived/
